description: Shape 10 (nearrank1024) has the weakest custom speedup among the large shapes — measured 90763us = only 1.16x under its 104950us cuSOLVER floor (vs ~2.3x for shape 4, ~2x for 5/11). It is NEAR-RANK-DEFICIENT: exact rank 3n/4=768, so ~256 near-null directions. It currently runs a low-rank k=768 peel + cluster. Mechanism: exploit the near-null tail explicitly — after peeling/solving the 768-rank dominant subspace, fill the ~256 tail eigenpairs WITHOUT a solve (near-zero eigenvalues; eigenvectors = an orthonormal basis of the complement of the dominant subspace via one CholeskyQR of the range-complement), gated by the measured tail spectral spread so a graded tail falls back. This removes the tail's contribution to the cluster/reduced solve. Targets redundant-work (solving a near-degenerate tail); keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

Free near-null tail on nearrank1024: skip A@Vc complement Rayleigh matvec, set lam_c:=0, gate on dominant block. MEASURED tail spread/||a||~1.6e-8, tail|lam|/||a||~3.7e-8, res(lam_c:=0)~1.5e-4 vs eig gate 1.8e-2 (tail ~1e6x below gate). 39/39 valid. geomean 27399us (parent 27342, noise); shape10 90009us vs 91203 parent. Profile: AVc removed (3 fewer 3xTF32 GEMM) but 768-rank cluster solve (mega_eigh_clust_split_k) is 66.8% of shape10 -- tail NOT bottleneck.

One project-out+CQR2 round for free-tail complement (vs two). REFUTED: shape10 211217us (+134%), 48/60 cuSOLVER fallbacks -- second project-out is load-bearing for orthonormality (Qd ill-conditioned kappa 1e3-1e4), independent of tail spectrum. 39/39 valid (fallback keeps correctness). geomean 29229us.

Free-tail KEEPER: skip A@Vc (lam_c:=0), gate dominant block directly (no zero-pad Res), two-round complement build kept (t3 one-round refuted). 39/39 valid, ZERO nearrank fallbacks. geomean 27388us (parent 27342, noise); shape10 89929us vs 91203 parent (~1.4%). Shapes 4/8/12 unchanged. free_tail gated n>=1024,k>=768.

2xTF32 free-tail complement projections (vs 3xTF32). REFUTED: shape10 171804us (+91% vs keeper), 45/60 orth-gate misses (NS rescues 42, 3 cuSOLVER). 2-term split's 1e-4 x kappa(Qd) 1e3-1e4 breaks cross-block orth regardless of near-null tail. Projections are orthonormality-bound. 39/39 valid. geomean 28733us.

FINAL KEEPER: free-tail A@Vc skip (lam_c:=0, dominant-block gate), both complement-cheapening variants gated off (one-CQR t3 + 2xTF32 t5 refuted -- complement build is orthonormality-bound vs ill-conditioned Qd). 39/39 valid, 0 nearrank fallbacks. geomean 27360us (parent 27342, 0.06% noise); shape10 89802us vs 91203 parent (~1.5%). No shape regresses. Shape-10 limited by 768-rank dominant cluster solve (73% of kernel time), NOT the tail.

FREE NEAR-NULL TAIL on nearrank1024 (shape 10). KEEPER commit 688a96e4aa59c1f723bfd8b774879ff46e230120: geomean 27360us (parent 029fa3b8 27342, within 0.06% noise), shape10 89802us vs 91203 parent (~1.5%, near noise), 39/39 valid, 0 nearrank fallbacks, no shape regresses (s4 45578, s8 80838, s12 29971 all flat).

WHAT I BUILT: (1) skip the A@Vc complement Rayleigh matvec on the near-rank route (n>=1024,k>=768) -- set lam_c:=0 (measured tail floor 2.8e-8) and gate on the dominant-block residual directly. This removes a real redundancy (the tail eigenvectors were ALREADY the free CholeskyQR complement basis in the parent; only lam_c and its residual block needed A@Vc). Confirmed by profile: 3 fewer 3xTF32 GEMM instances (20->17).

TAIL SPREAD I GATE ON (measured, shape 10): tail spread/||a|| = 1.6e-8 (mean), 2.1e-8 (max); tail |lam_c|/||a|| = 3.7e-8; res(lam_c:=0)/||a|| = 1.5e-4 (max 3.8e-4) vs eig gate 150*n*eps = 1.8e-2 -- the tail is ~1e6x below the gate and res(lam_c:=0) is 120x under gate. Dominant |lam_d|_min/||a|| = 0.1 (a hard rank-768 cliff: cond=0 nearrank has exactly 768 nonzero eigenvalues, so k=768 is forced and no smaller k is admissible). Contrast dense1024 (shape 4, k=608, FULL rank): tail spread/||a|| = 8e-5, res(lam_c:=0) = 7.5e-3 = ~40% of the gate -- correctly NOT free-tailed (stays on exact Rayleigh, gated by _lr_free_tail_for n>=1024,k>=768).

TAIL-vs-DOMINANT COST SPLIT (shape 10, 86.8ms kernel time in capture): DOMINANT 768-rank cluster solve = 73.0% (mega_eigh_clust_split_k 66.8% + its batch_trsm_left back-transform 6.2%); CholeskyQR potrf* 5.6%; TF32 matvecs 3.6%; FP32 simt GEMMs (Vd lift + complement project-out) 7.9%; elementwise+reduce (Res/norms/gates) 8.2%; other 1.7%. VERDICT: shape 10's weak 1.16x is limited by the DOMINANT 768-rank cluster solve, NOT the tail. The tail-specific work is at most ~10-12% and the A@Vc redundancy I removed was ~1%.

TWO TAIL-CHEAPENING VARIANTS REFUTED (both committed, gated off): (a) one project-out+CQR2 round for the complement (t3): shape10 +134%, 48/60 cuSOLVER fallbacks; (b) 2xTF32 complement projections (t5): shape10 +91%, 45/60 orth-gate misses. BOTH fail for the same reason: the complement build is ORTHONORMALITY-bound against ill-conditioned Qd (kappa 1e3-1e4), NOT tail-eigenvalue-bound -- so only the A@Vc Rayleigh (a genuine tail redundancy) is removable; the projection/CQR2 machinery that keeps Vc orthonormal is load-bearing regardless of the near-null tail.

OPEN DIRECTIONS for the manager (the real shape-10 lever is the 73% dominant cluster solve, which is OTHER briefs' territory -- brief-95 t13/t14 already tried occupancy/FLOP-balance on mega_eigh_clust_split_k, both neutral): (1) the 768-rank reduced block Bk=Qd^T A Qd currently goes to the C=3 CTA cluster solve because 768>448 (single-CTA megakernel ceiling) -- a direct batched dense solver that tiles k>448 out of SMEM, or a batched tensor-core tridiag for the reduced block, would attack the 58ms directly; (2) the huge dominant/tail spectral gap (0.1 vs 3.7e-8, ratio ~3e6) might enable a nested split WITHIN the 768 dominant block if its own spectrum is graded -- I did NOT probe the dominant-block spectrum shape (flat vs graded); (3) the free-tail A@Vc-skip generalizes to shape 8 (rankdef512, also exact rank 3n/4=384) and shape 12 (lapgeom1024) IF their tails are near-null -- I gated it to n>=1024,k>=768 (nearrank only) but the mechanism and _lr_free_tail_for are ready to widen; the tail-dbg run showed shape-8/12 tails are NOT near-null enough (res(lam_c:=0) ~5e-3) so they would fall back, but rankdef512's EXACT-rank structure may qualify under a per-matrix tail-spread gate that I did not build.
